site_name: Isleworth And Syon School For Boys
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and Design and Access Statement received 13th May 2010 and revised drawings Pr/37740/101 revision A and Pr/37740/102 revision A received 27th July 2010  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - No lighting shall be installed on the approved play area or enclosed fencing.

Condition : 4 - The approved play area shall only be used by the school and shall not be used separate from the school or used by members of the public not associated with the school out side school hours in the evenings or at weekends.
description: Construction of a new artificial turf sports pitch on part of the existing playing field including the erection of ball stop fencing
